reason: An orchestration plugin that uses a separately configured reviewer model to inspect primary agent turns and inject severity-ranked advisory notes into web or terminal sessions.

summaries.zh: 为对话会话接入独立的审查模型，观察主代理每轮内容并注入分级建议。
summaries.en: Adds an independently configured reviewer model that observes each primary agent turn and injects severity-ranked advisory notes into the session.

capabilities: Makes independent model calls using a configured provider and model
Reads primary conversation transcript deltas for review
Injects advisory messages and steer events into the active session
Provides web and terminal configuration and session controls
